title: Free Night Awards Protected Rebooking Price of a Returned Later Night
content:
**Clause.** The protected rebooking price stated on the return record of one of the Free Night Awards returned from a night after the first night of a reservation cancelled after its deadline is the stay's protected value recorded on the loss record of the stay's first-night award, in whole points. The protected rebooking price is never below zero.

**Reading the clause.**

| Element | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| The stay | The reservation cancelled after its deadline that the returned award paid a later night of |
| The stay's first-night award | The Free Night Award that paid the night of that reservation's arrival date |
| The stay's protected value | The points value stated on the loss record in that first-night award's history, for that reservation |
| The protected rebooking price | That value, in whole points |

### Worked figure (hypothetical stay)

A hypothetical three-night reservation is cancelled after its deadline. The loss record of the award that paid its arrival night states a stay's protected value of 28500 points. The awards on its second and third nights are each returned with a protected rebooking price of 28500 points on their return records.
